Measured on the linked-context runs of 2026-09-29 (4.1: 39.3M summed ctx, 99% cache reads, 149 turns, 410k peak).

tasks.title: Baseline from the 2026-09-29 linked-context runs: per task summed ctx, cache read/write, output, turns, peak ctx (task policy, runs 01M3PD3J… and 01M3PQW5…) vs the threshold-25% run 01M3PZHS…; PREDICT the saving before 2.x ships (bench-refresh D10)

Saved drive defaults in ~/.config/sofar/config.json on the keep-awake pattern: policy, threshold-pct, context-window, cost-cap, max-sessions; flags outrank saved values; `sofar drive --save-defaults` and `--show-defaults`
Threshold handoff on by default when the adapter reports the model's context window (never guessed); plain task policy only when the window is unknown, with a warning naming the flag
Handoff nudge requires a mid-task state note (what is done, what is half-done and why, what was tried and failed) before the session ends, so a mid-task handoff loses no reasoning
Run summary and handoff lines report cache read / cache write / output and turns per task instead of one summed ctx-token figure; estimated cost when the adapter reports prices
Same-task A/B (task policy vs threshold default) on a 4.1-sized task: total tokens, verify pass rate, rework after mid-task handoff; ship the default only if verify pass rate holds

payload.text: sofar drive passes the launching shell's env to every session and to the verify command. With FORCE_COLOR set (Ghostty sets it), the CLI renders its TTY UI and about 17 unit test files fail on plain-text assertions. On 2026-09-29 this reopened linked-context 4.2, 4.3 and 5.1 with 21 failures, and the suite passed 3309/3309 once FORCE_COLOR was unset. Start drive with `env -u FORCE_COLOR -u COLORTERM sofar drive …` until the driver scrubs them.

payload.title: Hermetic verify: the driver runs the verify command (and sessions) with FORCE_COLOR/COLORTERM/CLICOLOR_FORCE scrubbed, and vitest config pins them off, so a colour-forcing terminal cannot reopen green tasks (drive-cost M1)

Threshold overshoot: at 25% of 1M, linked-context run 01M3Q218 session c9ef6805 still summed 23.6M ctx before handing off — measure when the gauge fires versus the window actually used, and make the nudge land within one turn of the threshold

Under threshold policy a failed verify must stop packing: run 01M3PZHS kept building 4.3→5.2 on a red suite after 4.2 failed; the session is told its task reopened and hands off (or fixes it) before starting the next task

payload.note: Needs the operator's go-ahead: a live same-task A/B spends quota, and driven sessions cannot build the bench profile outside the worktree (linked-context 6.3 precedent). Ask before running.

The test half already landed as linked-context 05cc9955: test/setup-plain-env.ts strips an inherited FORCE_COLOR in the unit project. What remains is the driver half, scrubbing the colour env from the verify command and the sessions it launches.
